source.snippet: Every week another 'AI agent for X' launches. Email triage. Calendar coordination. Sales follow-up.... Stop Building AI Assistants. Build AI Firewalls. Score 6, 12 comments.

problem_statement: Businesses deploying AI agents for workflows (email, sales, scheduling) have no intermediary layer that validates, rate-limits, or blocks AI actions before they cause irreversible side effects — a gap that creates operational and compliance risk.
target_segment: SMB operators, SaaS founders, and operations teams deploying AI agents in customer-facing or internal business workflows.
notes: Recent post (2026-05-28) with 12 comments signals active discussion. The 'AI firewall' framing is gaining traction alongside the agent-bankrupting-operator story above — two independent signals pointing at the same gap. Businesses already spending on AI automation are natural buyers for a guardrail layer. Possible productization: a middleware SDK or SaaS proxy for AI agent action validation.
